sets.label: 10x Multiome
sets.summary: single-nucleus ATAC-seq (10x multiome), single-nucleus RNA sequencing assay (10x multiome) (genetically multiplexed)
sets.description: This is the principal analysis set consisting of files relevant to the 10X Multiome component of a fibroblast-to-iPSC reprogramming trajectory profiling four individuals from the Personal Genomes Project (PGP), as part of the Luo award in the Networks group. Files include final QC of snRNA/snATAC data with downstream analyses such as differential genes, peaks, and cell annotations.

sets.label: Spatial (CosMx)
sets.description: This is the principal analysis set consisting of files relevant to the spatial RNA component of a fibroblast-to-iPSC reprogramming trajectory profiling four individuals from the Personal Genomes Project (PGP), as part of the Luo award in the Networks group. Files include final QC of three separate spatial RNA experiments (IGVFFI2804FOOR, IGVFFI3564FUQJ, and IGVFFI9846GOMO). IGVFFI2804FOOR and IGVFFI3564FUQJ are pilot spatial experiments used for orthogonal validation (identifying spatial RNA specific fibroblast/iPSC relevant genes used for trajectory scoring), while IGVFFI9846GOMO represents the main spatial RNA data used in the manuscript (individuals C29/C38); the cell annotations reflect cells from that set.
sets.sample_summary: human fibroblast pooled reprogrammed cell specimen induced to induced pluripotent stem cell at 6 day, 13 day, 30 day(s) post change from donor(s) IGVFDO2328XGNY, IGVFDO3565PTIO and 1 more

sets.label: WGS
sets.description: This is the principal analysis set consisting of files relevant to the WGS component of a fibroblast-to-iPSC reprogramming trajectory profiling four individuals from the Personal Genomes Project (PGP), as part of the Luo award in the Networks group. This set includes the VCF used for genotype-based demultiplexing in the 10X Multiome component of the project.
